fields.Name: T108 - Query Panel Resize Persistence
fields.Description: Exercises the onResizeStart/onResizeMove/onResizeEnd drag pipeline that resizes and persists PanelWidth — a bespoke resize interaction, not a standard splitter component.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, switch to Data Explorer, and open the Queries section. Between the left query tree panel and the right query viewer there is a vertical resize handle (a draggable grip). Drag the handle left or right to change the width of the left query panel, then release. Success is the left panel visibly changing width in response to the drag (and staying at the new width). You do NOT need to verify persistence across reloads. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A vertical resize handle/grip exists between the query tree panel and the viewer
Dragging the handle visibly changes the left query panel's width and it holds the new width after release
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
